meta.name: SimVenture
meta.refresh_cadence: quarterly — product-only benchmark, low expected rate of change; not worth a tighter cadence given thin public footprint

snapshot.one_liner: UK-based business-simulation EdTech suite: Evolution (run/scale a full virtual venture) and Validate (ideate/validate a business concept), plus a legacy 'Classic' product; course-embedded in higher ed.
snapshot.why_they_compete: Gamified plus tools plus course-embedded; Validate maps closely to Altitut's idea/validation flow, per COMPETITORS.md (#4 of 10).

positioning.value_prop: 'Award-winning' simulations used by educators/training providers in 40+ countries; Evolution positioned as 'the most powerful and sophisticated business simulation on the market,' with a 2025 'Pathways' step-by-step guidance addition.
positioning.differentiation: The Validate → Evolution product split (concept-testing tool feeding into a full-scale-the-venture simulation) formalizes a natural student journey as two distinct products/modules.

1_identity.audience_icp: Higher-ed and school business/entrepreneurship educators, plus corporate training providers — instructor-led, course-embedded model.

similarity_to_us.rationale: Strong match on the gamified-plus-tools-plus-course-embedded axis; Validate specifically overlaps with Altitut's idea/validation tools. Directional judgment, not a scoring model.

highlight_features.why_pushed: Flagship product, positioned as the most sophisticated simulation on the market.
Entry-point product for idea-stage users, feeding into Evolution.
Recent product update addressing a guided-journey gap.

most_attractive_features.why_it_lands: Gives students a clear, staged journey from idea-testing to full venture management rather than one flat simulation.
